title: Paint Coverage Methodology
overview: Paint calculations estimate gallons needed based on surface area and coverage rate. Multiple coats and surface texture significantly affect requirements.

methods.name: Standard Coverage Rate
methods.description: Most interior paints cover 350-400 sq ft per gallon on smooth surfaces.

formula.name: Paint Calculation
formula.expression:
Gallons = (Wall Area × Coats) / Coverage Rate
Wall Area = Perimeter × Height - Openings

footnotes: Dark to light color changes may need 3+ coats
